module: Master Spline tool utility module: groups dispatch tables keyed by a layer's link type (tool prefix of meshSpline, assemblySpline, decalSpline, roadSpline, treeSpline). Each table maps that type to the matching tool function (create, restore, unlink, delete, lock, serialize...). Useful to understand how a Master Spline drives its child splines.
notes: All the tables are keyed by the string returned by each tool's getToolPrefixStr() (layer.linkType).
The module only exports tables, no functions; the call is made through jumps.xxxJumpTable[linkType](...).
eachObjectJumpTable only covers mesh and assembly (the only tools whose manual changes can be restored after undoing an unlock).
For the road (roadSpline), the functions come from groupMgr (groups) and not from a splineMgr.

setLinkJumpTable.desc: setLink of each tool: sets the link state of a layer.

setNameJumpTable.desc: Renames the linked spline (name field); for mesh, assembly and road, also renames the scene tree folder (sceneTreeFolderId) and refreshes the tree window.

createJumpTable.desc: Creates a new spline in the target tool (addNewMeshSpline, addNewAssemblySpline, addNewDecalSpline, addNewGroup, addNewTreeSpline).

getLastCreatedSplineJumpTable.desc: Returns the last spline of the tool's list (or nil if empty); optimized for undo/redo.

restoreJumpTable.desc: Restores a spline from data: deep copy, added to the tool's list, id-to-index table recomputed; returns the spline.

unlinkJumpTable.desc: Unlinks the spline: isLink = false, linkId = nil, isDirty = true.

removeJumpTable.desc: Deletes a linked spline (removeLinkedXxx of each tool).

setLockedJumpTable.desc: Locks/unlocks a child spline via the tool's setLockedById; follows the lock of its Master Spline.

eachObjectJumpTable.desc: Iterates over the objects of a linked spline (eachObjectById), for splineLock; mesh and assembly only.

setLinkedSplineDirtyJumpTable.desc: Sets isDirty = true on the linked spline, if it exists.

serializeJumpTable.desc: Returns a deep copy of the linked spline (deepCopyXxx), or nil if not found.

toolNavigation.desc: For each type: uiModule (extension name, e.g. 'editor_meshSpline'), getModeKey, getSplines and getIdToIdxMap, to navigate to the matching tool.
